notes: v1.0.35 fixes the crash when expanding "Thinking" or a file diff in the project chat (every expandable section is now height-bounded and scroll-safe; a build-time guard test fails on that pattern forever), and the phone's file-sync failures: the Z.ai conversation id is captured the moment it appears and stored per project (one conversation per project; sync targets the stored id, never the current URL), the finished reply is retried with backoff for ~30 s with a redacted diagnostic (selector hits, stop-button state, reply length) shown on the honesty card, duplicate "Thinking..." lines are collapsed into one live block, file sources follow the reply-first order (reply FILE: blocks > site sandbox data > visible code blocks), the sync card shows the EXACT failure reason, and a new "Paste reply" button imports files from pasted reply text through the same safety pipeline (relative paths only, size caps, conflict choices, undo). Z.ai projects keep the same Chat / Files / Terminal / Preview tabs as Antigravity (verified by tests). Installs over v1.0.34 keeping all data; nothing new runs at startup.
